'''G. Christensen Hoth Command Center''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[G. Christensen]]
* '''Published:''' May 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)|Hoth-L-hothdefensiveperimeter.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth Command Center
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Hoth Command Center Christensen LS.txt |Download]]
